.hero-headline.en: Armin Maglić is an engineer and maker giving shape to ideas through software, hardware, and strategic growth.
.hero-headline.bs: Armin Maglić je inženjer i kreator koji daje oblik idejama kroz softver, hardver i strateški rast.

.hero-bio.en: Four years of freelance experience with international clients across LA, Paris, Duisburg, and Berlin, paired with local market knowledge in Bosnia and Herzegovina. I specialize in e-commerce websites with SEO at the foundation—building systems that drive real business outcomes.
.hero-bio.bs: Četiri godine frilenserskog iskustva s međunarodnim klijentima iz Los Angelesa, Pariza, Duisburga i Berlina, uz poznavanje lokalnog tržišta u Bosni i Hercegovini. Specijalizirao sam se za izradu e-commerce web-stranica sa integrisanim SEO-om — gradim sisteme koji donose stvarne poslovne rezultate.

.sub-message-text.en: If you think I can help you build something, or if you just want to meet, drop me an email.
.sub-message-text.bs: Ako mislite da vam mogu pomoći da nešto izgradite, ili ako se samo želite upoznati, pošaljite mi e-mail.

#product .section-title.en: STEM Pionir: Robotics for the Next Generation
#product .section-title.bs: STEM Pionir: Robotika za sljedeću generaciju

#product .section-desc.en: Designing and manufacturing Bosnia's first screen-free STEM toy. This was a platform built from the ground up, requiring a fusion of mechanical engineering, electronic design, and pedagogical strategy.
#product .section-desc.bs: Dizajniranje i proizvodnja prve bosanske STEM igračke bez ekrana. Riječ je o platformi izgrađenoj od nule, koja je zahtijevala spoj mašinstva, dizajna elektronike i pedagoške strategije.

#stem-toy-technical .star-item:nth-child.en: Educational robotics kits were either plastic-heavy toys with low durability or complex systems requiring screens and immediate coding knowledge, creating high barriers to entry.
#stem-toy-technical .star-item:nth-child.bs: Edukativni robotički setovi su bili ili krhke plastične igračke niske trajnosti ili složeni sistemi koji zahtijevaju ekrane i predznanje o kodiranju, što je stvaralo visoke prepreke za ulazak.

#stem-toy-technical .star-item:nth-child.en: Develop a modular, durable, and screen-free robotics kit that teaches fundamental mechanics and electronics to children aged 7-15.
#stem-toy-technical .star-item:nth-child.bs: Razviti modularan, trajan robotički set bez ekrana koji djecu uzrasta od 7 do 15 godina uči osnovama mehanike i elektronike.

#stem-toy-technical .star-item:nth-child.en: Engineered a modular wooden construction system using real mechanical fasteners. Designed basic electronic circuits with DC motors to teach physics principles without software complexity.
#stem-toy-technical .star-item:nth-child.bs: Konstruisao sam modularni drveni sistem koristeći prave mehaničke spojnice. Dizajnirao sam osnovna elektronska kola sa DC motorima kako bih prenio principe fizike bez softverske kompleksnosti.

#stem-toy-technical .star-item:nth-child.en: Successfully launched a sustainable learning platform used in 15+ schools, improving spatial intelligence and mechanical debugging skills in thousands of children.
#stem-toy-technical .star-item:nth-child.bs: Uspješno sam lansirao održivu platformu za učenje koja se koristi u više od 15 škola, čime su poboljšane prostorna inteligencija i vještine rješavanja mehaničkih problema kod hiljada djece.

#stem-toy-impact .ps-block:nth-child(1).en: Most STEM toys follow a "build once" manual. Once the model is complete, the learning stops, and the toy is abandoned, offering no long-term engagement or creative freedom.
#stem-toy-impact .ps-block:nth-child(1).bs: Većina STEM igračaka prati priručnik po principu 'izgradi jednom'. Nakon što se model sklopi, učenje prestaje, a igračka se napušta, bez pružanja dugoročnog angažmana ili kreativne slobode.

#stem-toy-impact .ps-block:nth-child(2).en: Designed the STEM Pionir as a constructionist toolset. The same components build drawing robots, catapults, or vehicles. Shifting focus from "What to build" to "How mechanics work," fostering a growth mindset.
#stem-toy-impact .ps-block:nth-child(2).bs: Dizajnirao sam STEM Pionir kao konstruktivistički set alata. Pomoću istih komponenti mogu se izgraditi roboti za crtanje, katapulti ili vozila. Time se fokus pomjera sa 'Šta izgraditi' na 'Kako mehanika funkcioniše', razvijajući mentalitet rasta.

#webdev .section-desc.en: Building production WordPress plugins, AI-powered search systems, and semantic SEO infrastructure. My focus is on scalable e-commerce architectures, API integrations, and tools that reduce operational overhead.
#webdev .section-desc.bs: Izrada produkcijskih WordPress dodataka, sistema pretrage na bazi AI i semantičke SEO infrastrukture. Moj fokus je na skalabilnim e-commerce arhitekturama, API integracijama i alatima koji smanjuju operativne troškove.

#tea-recipe .framework-title.bs: 🍵 Dodatak za upravljanje receptima za čaj

#tea-recipe .showcase-title-area .ps-con.en: Custom WordPress Tool for Production Operations
#tea-recipe .showcase-title-area .ps-con.bs: Prilagođeni WordPress alat za proizvodne operacije

#tea-recipe > p.ps-content.en: A specialized internal system designed to bridge the gap between production recipes and real-time inventory costs. It automates financial tracking for tea blends while providing employees with a digital logging interface for food safety compliance. Built with WordPress actions for plugin compatibility and HMAC webhooks for secure inventory updates.
#tea-recipe > p.ps-content.bs: Specijalizirani interni sistem dizajniran da premosti jaz između proizvodnih recepata i troškova zaliha u realnom vremenu. Automatizuje finansijsko praćenje mješavina čajeva, pružajući zaposlenicima digitalni interfejs za vođenje evidencije u skladu sa propisima o sigurnosti hrane. Izgrađen uz korištenje WordPress akcija (hooks) i HMAC webhookova za sigurno ažuriranje zaliha.

#tea-recipe .feature-item:nth-child(1) s.en: Hiboutik API Sync: Real-time cost fetching for ingredient precision.
#tea-recipe .feature-item:nth-child(1) s.bs: Hiboutik API sinhronizacija: Preuzimanje troškova u realnom vremenu za visoku preciznost sastojaka.

#tea-recipe .feature-item:nth-child(2) s.en: Production Logging: Digital lot/DLUO tracking for safety audits.
#tea-recipe .feature-item:nth-child(2) s.bs: Proizvodna evidencija: Digitalno praćenje serija (lot) i rokova trajanja (DLUO) za sigurnosne provjere.

#tea-recipe .feature-item:nth-child(3) s.en: Dynamic Costing: Automatic calculation of total price per 100g.
#tea-recipe .feature-item:nth-child(3) s.bs: Dinamički proračun troškova: Automatska kalkulacija ukupne cijene po 100g.

#siegmann-ai .framework-title.bs: 🖼️ SiegmannStock AI Vision i proces za automatsko određivanje cijena

#siegmann-ai .showcase-title-area .ps-co.en: Production AI Asset Enrichment for WooCommerce
#siegmann-ai .showcase-title-area .ps-co.bs: AI obogaćivanje digitalnog sadržaja za WooCommerce

#siegmann-ai > p.ps-content.en: Automated suite that classifies, scores, and prices stock photography at scale using multi-modal AI. Replaced manual categorization with a YAML-based scoring engine that evaluates images across conceptual, commercial, and technical axes. Uses GLM-4.5V for multilingual support and non-developer rule management.
#siegmann-ai > p.ps-content.bs: Automatizovani sistem koji klasifikuje, ocjenjuje i određuje cijene stock fotografija u velikom obimu koristeći multimodalni AI. Ručna kategorizacija zamijenjena je mehanizmom za bodovanje zasnovanim na YAML-u koji procjenjuje slike kroz konceptualne, komercijalne i tehničke aspekte. Koristi GLM-4.5V model za višejezičnu podršku i jednostavno upravljanje pravilima.

#siegmann-ai .feature-item:nth-child(1).en: Multi-Modal Classification: Routes assets into typed collections using GLM-4.5V vision analysis.
#siegmann-ai .feature-item:nth-child(1).bs: Multimodalna klasifikacija: Raspoređivanje resursa u tipizirane kolekcije pomoću vizuelne analize GLM-4.5V modela.

#siegmann-ai .feature-item:nth-child(2).en: Rule-Based Pricing Engine: YAML-driven scoring that eliminates underpricing.
#siegmann-ai .feature-item:nth-child(2).bs: Mehanizam za određivanje cijena: Bodovanje vođeno YAML konfiguracijom koje eliminiše preniske cijene.

#siegmann-ai .feature-item:nth-child(3).en: Universal Reasoning: Architected for scalable reasoning rather than category-specific prompts.
#siegmann-ai .feature-item:nth-child(3).bs: Univerzalno zaključivanje: Arhitektura prilagođena skalabilnom zaključivanju umjesto upita specifičnih za pojedinačne kategorije.

#sublimoss .showcase-title-area .ps-cont.en: Brand Build & Conversion Strategy for French Wellness Market
#sublimoss .showcase-title-area .ps-cont.bs: Izgradnja brenda i strategija konverzije za francusko wellness tržište

#sublimoss > p.ps-content.en: End-to-end page architecture for a French sea moss brand. Translated complex nutritional specs into high-conversion narratives using psychological clustering and lean design principles.
#sublimoss > p.ps-content.bs: Kompletna arhitektura stranice za francuski brend morske mahovine. Složene nutritivne specifikacije prevedene su u narative visoke stope konverzije koristeći psihološko klasterisanje i principe lean dizajna.

#sublimoss .feature-item:nth-child(1) sp.en: Psychological Optimization: Aligned narratives with French wellness market trust requirements.
#sublimoss .feature-item:nth-child(1) sp.bs: Psihološka optimizacija: Usklađivanje narativa sa zahtjevima povjerenja francuskog wellness tržišta.

#sublimoss .feature-item:nth-child(2) sp.en: Conversion-First Design: Bridged technical benefits with immediate consumer needs.
#sublimoss .feature-item:nth-child(2) sp.bs: Dizajn fokusiran na konverziju: Povezivanje tehničkih prednosti sa neposrednim potrebama kupaca.

#sublimoss .feature-item:nth-child(3) sp.en: Semantic Grounding: Structured content for long-term organic authority.
#sublimoss .feature-item:nth-child(3) sp.bs: Semantičko utemeljenje: Strukturiranje sadržaja za postizanje dugoročnog organskog autoriteta.

#rawear-crm .framework-title.bs: 💼 B2B RAWEAR: CRM za prodajnu inteligenciju

#rawear-crm .showcase-title-area .ps-con.en: Behavioral Psychology + AI-Powered B2B Outreach System
#rawear-crm .showcase-title-area .ps-con.bs: Bihevioralna psihologija + B2B komunikacijski sistem vođen AI-jem

#rawear-crm > p.ps-content.en: Full-Stack CRM combining behavioral psychology with AI-powered sales intelligence for hyper-personalized B2B outreach. Analyzes fear patterns, identifies cognitive hooks, and maps behavioral signals to optimal sales strategies using AJAX for responsive workflows.
#rawear-crm > p.ps-content.bs: Full-Stack CRM koji kombinuje bihevioralnu psihologiju sa prodajnom inteligencijom na bazi AI-a za hiper-personalizovanu B2B komunikaciju. Analizira obrasce straha, identifikuje kognitivne okidače i mapira bihevioralne signale u optimalne prodajne strategije uz korištenje AJAX-a.

#rawear-crm .feature-item:nth-child(1) s.en: Cognitive Profiles: Each company gets fear patterns, pain points, and cognitive hooks.
#rawear-crm .feature-item:nth-child(1) s.bs: Kognitivni profili: Svaka kompanija dobija definisane obrasce straha, bolne tačke (pain points) i kognitivne okidače.

#rawear-crm .feature-item:nth-child(2) s.en: AI Email Generation: Automated emails incorporating RAWEAR intelligence and review data.
#rawear-crm .feature-item:nth-child(2) s.bs: AI generisanje e-mailova: Automatizovani e-mailovi koji integrišu RAWEAR inteligenciju i podatke iz recenzija.

#rawear-crm .feature-item:nth-child(3) s.en: Strategy Selection: Auto-recommends best sales framework based on company profile.
#rawear-crm .feature-item:nth-child(3) s.bs: Odabir strategije: Automatska preporuka najboljeg prodajnog okvira na osnovu profila kompanije.

#content-pipeline > p.ps-content.en: Production infrastructure that transforms content production into a compounding data asset. Captures behavioral intelligence using Redis-backed caching to reduce LLM API costs.
#content-pipeline > p.ps-content.bs: Proizvodna infrastruktura koja transformiše proizvodnju sadržaja u podatkovnu vrijednost koja se vremenom akumulira. Bilježi psihološke uvide koristeći Redis keširanje radi optimizacije troškova LLM API-ja.

#content-pipeline .feature-item:nth-chil.en: Pattern Recognition: Learns which emotional states dominate product categories.
#content-pipeline .feature-item:nth-chil.bs: Prepoznavanje obrazaca: Učenje o tome koja emocionalna stanja dominiraju određenim kategorijama proizvoda.

#content-pipeline .feature-item:nth-chil.en: Exit Data: Tracks what unresolved variables cause visitors to leave.
#content-pipeline .feature-item:nth-chil.bs: Podaci o izlazima: Praćenje neriješenih varijabli koje navode posjetioce da napuste stranicu.

#content-pipeline .feature-item:nth-chil.en: Real-World Signals: Mandates verbatim quotes and surveys that can't be synthesized.
#content-pipeline .feature-item:nth-chil.bs: Signali iz stvarnog svijeta: Obavezno uključivanje autentičnih citata i anketa koje se ne mogu sintetički generisati.

#woo-cart-widget .showcase-title-area .p.en: Customizable WooCommerce Widget with Elementor Integration
#woo-cart-widget .showcase-title-area .p.bs: Prilagodljivi WooCommerce widget sa Elementor integracijom

#woo-cart-widget > p.ps-content.en: Adds a modern, configurable cart widget to WooCommerce storefronts with Elementor compatibility. Built as a WordPress plugin with widget controls for icon style, subtotal display, and theme colors.
#woo-cart-widget > p.ps-content.bs: Dodaje moderan i prilagodljiv vidžet korpe na WooCommerce prodavnice sa Elementor kompatibilnošću. Razvijen kao WordPress dodatak s postavkama za stil ikone, prikaz međuzbira i boje teme.

#woo-cart-widget .feature-item:nth-child.en: Widget Customization: Choose cart icon style (Cart, Bag, Basket) and toggle subtotal display.
#woo-cart-widget .feature-item:nth-child.bs: Prilagođavanje vidžeta: Odabir stila ikone korpe (korpa, torba, košarica) i prikaz međuzbira (subtotal).

#woo-cart-widget .feature-item:nth-child.en: Elementor Integration: Includes a native WooCommerce Cart widget in the Elementor panel.
#woo-cart-widget .feature-item:nth-child.bs: Elementor integracija: Uključuje nativni WooCommerce Cart vidžet u Elementor panelu.

#woo-cart-widget .feature-item:nth-child.en: Responsive: Designed to adapt cleanly across desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts.
#woo-cart-widget .feature-item:nth-child.bs: Responzivnost: Dizajniran za besprijekornu prilagodbu na desktopu, tabletu i mobilnim uređajima.

#hiboutik-sync .showcase-title-area .ps-.en: POS to WooCommerce Product & Stock Synchronization
#hiboutik-sync .showcase-title-area .ps-.bs: POS do WooCommerce sinhronizacija proizvoda i zaliha

#hiboutik-sync > p.ps-content.en: Production sync plugin treating Hiboutik POS as the source of truth for price and stock. Supports background bulk imports with progress tracking, barcode-to-SKU matching, and HMAC-secured webhooks for real-time updates.
#hiboutik-sync > p.ps-content.bs: Produkcijski dodatak za sinhronizaciju koji tretira Hiboutik POS kao izvor istine za cijene i zalihe. Podržava pozadinski grupni uvoz s praćenjem napretka, povezivanje bar-koda sa SKU-om i HMAC zaštićene web-hookove za ažuriranje u realnom vremenu.

#hiboutik-sync .feature-item:nth-child(1.en: Product Sync: One-way sync from Hiboutik into WooCommerce with variable-product support.
#hiboutik-sync .feature-item:nth-child(1.bs: Sinhronizacija proizvoda: Jednosmjerna sinhronizacija iz Hiboutik-a u WooCommerce s podrškom za varijabilne proizvode.

#hiboutik-sync .feature-item:nth-child(2.en: Batch Processing: Background sync with progress tracking, cancellation, and resume.
#hiboutik-sync .feature-item:nth-child(2.bs: Grupna obrada: Pozadinska sinhronizacija s praćenjem napretka, opcijama otkazivanja i nastavka.

#hiboutik-sync .feature-item:nth-child(3.en: Mapping & Validation: Field, category, and attribute mapping with SKU/barcode validation.
#hiboutik-sync .feature-item:nth-child(3.bs: Mapiranje i validacija: Mapiranje polja, kategorija i atributa s validacijom SKU-a i bar-koda.

#image-seo-metadata-processor .showcase-.en: Parallel Batch SEO Metadata Generation with Gemini 2.5 Flash
#image-seo-metadata-processor .showcase-.bs: Paralelna batch generacija SEO metapodataka sa Gemini 2.5 Flash

#image-seo-metadata-processor > p.ps-con.en: Pipeline that analyzes product images at scale and generates SEO-ready metadata. Uses Gemini 2.5 Flash with worker pool parallel processing and content hash caching to reduce API costs by 60%.
#image-seo-metadata-processor > p.ps-con.bs: Sistem koji analizira slike proizvoda u velikom obimu i generiše SEO metapodatke. Koristi Gemini 2.5 Flash model s paralelnim procesiranjem i keširanjem putem hasha sadržaja, što smanjuje troškove API-ja za 60%.

#image-seo-metadata-processor .feature-i.en: AI Analysis: Semantic content, image quality, and commercial context evaluation.
#image-seo-metadata-processor .feature-i.bs: AI analiza: Evaluacija semantičkog sadržaja, kvaliteta slika i komercijalnog konteksta.

#image-seo-metadata-processor .feature-i.en: Parallel Processing: Batch image processing with worker-based concurrency and caching.
#image-seo-metadata-processor .feature-i.bs: Paralelna obrada: Grupna obrada slika s konkurentnošću zasnovanom na radnim nitima (worker) i keširanjem.

#image-seo-metadata-processor .feature-i.en: Metadata Output: HTML metadata, Open Graph/Twitter tags, and JSON-LD structured data.
#image-seo-metadata-processor .feature-i.bs: Izlazni metapodaci: HTML metapodaci, Open Graph/Twitter tagovi i JSON-LD strukturirani podaci.

#image-metadata-tool .showcase-title-are.en: Automated SEO Metadata Enrichment for E-Commerce Images
#image-metadata-tool .showcase-title-are.bs: Automatizovano obogaćenje SEO metapodataka za e-commerce slike

#image-metadata-tool > p.ps-content.en: Automated image enrichment pipeline for e-commerce feeds. Reads product CSVs with image URLs, generates SEO-focused metadata via AI, runs technical SEO checks, and writes enriched output plus optimized local image copies.
#image-metadata-tool > p.ps-content.bs: Automatizovani proces obogaćivanja slika za e-commerce feedove. Čita CSV datoteke sa URL-ovima slika, generiše SEO metapodatke putem AI-ja, vrši tehničke SEO provjere i kreira lokalne optimizovane kopije slika.

#image-metadata-tool .feature-item:nth-c.en: AI Enrichment: Uses Gemini for primary metadata generation, with OpenAI fallback.
#image-metadata-tool .feature-item:nth-c.bs: AI obogaćivanje: Korištenje Gemini modela za primarnu generaciju metapodataka, uz OpenAI kao alternativnu opciju (fallback).

#image-metadata-tool .feature-item:nth-c.en: Technical SEO Checks: Validates dimensions, format, file size, and aspect ratio; recommends improvements.
#image-metadata-tool .feature-item:nth-c.bs: Tehničke SEO provjere: Validacija dimenzija, formata, veličine datoteka i omjera stranica, uz preporuke za poboljšanje.

#image-metadata-tool .feature-item:nth-c.en: CSV-Driven: Reads structured product CSVs, writes enriched columns, and copies renamed SEO-friendly images.
#image-metadata-tool .feature-item:nth-c.bs: Vođeno CSV datotekama: Čitanje strukturiranih CSV datoteka proizvoda, upisivanje obogaćenih kolona i kopiranje preimenovanih SEO-friendly slika.

#image-metadata-tool .feature-item:nth-c.en: WooCommerce Helper: Includes a WordPress snippet to expose attached WooCommerce variation/gallery images in Media Library.
#image-metadata-tool .feature-item:nth-c.bs: WooCommerce pomoćnik: Sadrži WordPress snippet koji omogućava prikaz priloženih slika varijacija i galerija u Media Library sekciji.

#stock-multiplier .showcase-title-area ..en: Bulk & Variable Stock Control for WooCommerce
#stock-multiplier .showcase-title-area ..bs: Kontrola zaliha u velikim količinama i varijablama za WooCommerce

#stock-multiplier > p.ps-content.en: A production-ready plugin that gives store owners complete control over stock quantities with adjustable multipliers. Supports simple products, variable products, global defaults, bulk updates, and frontend AJAX updates.
#stock-multiplier > p.ps-content.bs: Dodatak spreman za produkciju koji vlasnicima trgovina pruža potpunu kontrolu nad količinama zaliha putem prilagodljivih množitelja. Podržava jednostavne i varijabilne proizvode, globalne zadane vrijednosti te AJAX ažuriranja.

#stock-multiplier .feature-item:nth-chil.en: Simple & Variable Products: Per-product or per-variation multiplier fields in the product editor.
#stock-multiplier .feature-item:nth-chil.bs: Jednostavni i varijabilni proizvodi: Polja za unos množitelja po proizvodu ili varijaciji unutar editora proizvoda.

#stock-multiplier .feature-item:nth-chil.en: Global Default: Site-wide fallback multiplier via plugin settings.
#stock-multiplier .feature-item:nth-chil.bs: Globalne podrazumijevane vrijednosti: Rezervni množitelj na nivou cijelog sajta putem postavki dodatka.

#stock-multiplier .feature-item:nth-chil.en: Bulk Update: Apply multipliers to multiple products at once from the Products screen.
#stock-multiplier .feature-item:nth-chil.bs: Grupno ažuriranje: Primjena množitelja na više proizvoda odjednom sa ekrana proizvoda.

#stock-multiplier .feature-item:nth-chil.en: Frontend AJAX: Adjusted quantities render dynamically on product pages without full reloads.
#stock-multiplier .feature-item:nth-chil.bs: Frontend AJAX: Prilagođene količine se dinamički prikazuju na stranicama proizvoda bez potrebe za ponovnim učitavanjem.

#stock-multiplier .feature-item:nth-chil.en: Extensible: Hooks and filters available for custom integrations.
#stock-multiplier .feature-item:nth-chil.bs: Proširivost: Hooks i filteri dostupni za prilagođene integracije.

#musa-app .showcase-title-area .ps-conte.en: Local Museum Experience — Dedicated to a Famous Bosnian Poet
#musa-app .showcase-title-area .ps-conte.bs: Iskustvo lokalnog muzeja — Posvećeno poznatom bosanskom pjesniku

#musa-app > p.ps-content.en: Built a focused web app for a local museum honoring a prominent Bosnian poet. Designed for storytelling and visitor engagement around biography, poems, and historical context.
#musa-app > p.ps-content.bs: Kreirao sam namjensku web aplikaciju za lokalni muzej koji slavi poznatog bosanskog pjesnika (Musa Ćazim Ćatić). Dizajnirana za interaktivno predstavljanje biografije, poezije i historijskog konteksta.

#musa-app .feature-item:nth-child(1) spa.en: Poet Biography & Timeline: Structured presentation of life milestones and historical context.
#musa-app .feature-item:nth-child(1) spa.bs: Biografija i vremenska linija pjesnika: Strukturirani prikaz životnih prekretnica i historijskog konteksta.

#musa-app .feature-item:nth-child(2) spa.en: Poetry Showcase: Organized poem listings with readable typography and search navigation.
#musa-app .feature-item:nth-child(2) spa.bs: Prezentacija poezije: Organizovana lista pjesama s čitljivom tipografijom i pretragom.

#musa-app .feature-item:nth-child(3) spa.en: Exhibit & Archive Sections: Highlights artifacts, documents, and curated exhibitions.
#musa-app .feature-item:nth-child(3) spa.bs: Sekcije za eksponate i arhiv: Isticanje artefakata, dokumenata i kuriranih izložbi.

#musa-app .feature-item:nth-child(4) spa.en: Visitor-First Experience: Clean browsing interface suited for museum visitor screens and simple navigation.

#seo .section-desc.en: Search Is About Decisions, Not Keywords.
#seo .section-desc.bs: Pretraga je o odlukama, ne ključnim riječima.

#seo-problem .framework-title.en: The Problem: Random Content Creates Random Results
#seo-problem .framework-title.bs: Problem: Nasumični sadržaj stvara nasumične rezultate

#seo-problem .ps-content.en: Traditional SEO teaches you to chase individual terms. Write for keywords. Build links. Hope. That approach treats search engines like slot machines — when the real engine is an LLM reading your site the same way a human analyst reads a document. It follows structure. It verifies facts. It remembers consistency.
#seo-problem .ps-content.bs: Tradicionalni SEO vas uči da jurite pojedinačne pojmove: pišite za ključne riječi, gradite linkove i nadajte se najboljem. Taj pristup tretira pretraživače kao aparate na sreću — iako je stvarni mehanizam zapravo LLM koji čita vašu stranicu na isti način kao što ljudski analitičar čita dokument. On prati strukturu, provjerava činjenice i vrednuje konzistentnost.

.comparison-wrong .comparison-text.en: Keywords placed by chance, blog posts published in bursts, competitors outranking with thinner content
.comparison-wrong .comparison-text.bs: Ključne riječi postavljene nasumično, blog objave objavljene stihijski, konkurenti koji rangiraju više sa znatno tanjim sadržajem

.comparison-right .comparison-text.en: Structured authority, semantic networks, predictable growth built on machine-readable truth
.comparison-right .comparison-text.bs: Strukturirani autoritet, semantičke mreže i predvidljiv rast izgrađen na mašinski čitljivoj istini

#seo .positioning-text.en: Most SEO focuses on ranking pages. I focus on understanding why people search in the first place. The goal isn't traffic — the goal is becoming the safest decision in the customer's mind.
#seo .positioning-text.bs: Većina SEO pristupa se fokusira na rangiranje stranica. Ja se fokusiram na razumijevanje zašto ljudi uopšte pretražuju. Cilj nije puki saobraćaj — cilj je postati najsigurnija odluka u svijesti kupca.

#seo .positioning-subtext.en: I don't optimize websites for algorithms. I design search experiences that help both humans and machines arrive at the same conclusion: this is the right answer.
#seo .positioning-subtext.bs: Ne optimizujem web-stranice za algoritme. Dizajniram iskustva pretrage koja pomažu i ljudima i mašinama da dođu do istog zaključka: ovo je tačan odgovor.

#seo .pillar-card:nth-child(1) .pillar-d.en: Understanding what triggers a search, what questions appear next, what creates trust, what creates doubt, and what makes users choose one brand over another
#seo .pillar-card:nth-child(1) .pillar-d.bs: Razumijevanje šta pokreće pretragu, koja se pitanja pojavljuju sljedeća, šta gradi povjerenje, šta stvara sumnju i zašto korisnici biraju jedan brend umjesto drugog

#seo .pillar-card:nth-child(2) .pillar-d.en: Designing topical maps, internal linking systems, knowledge hubs, and contextual pathways where every page has a purpose and every link has a reason
#seo .pillar-card:nth-child(2) .pillar-d.bs: Dizajniranje tematskih mapa (topical maps), sistema internog linkovanja, baza znanja i kontekstualnih puteva gdje svaka stranica ima svrhu, a svaki link jasan razlog

#seo-machine .ps-content.en: Every search has a visible layer (the query) and a hidden layer (the psychological reality). Traditional SEO optimizes for the query. I optimize for the reality.
#seo-machine .ps-content.bs: Svaka pretraga ima svoj vidljivi sloj (upit) i skriveni sloj (psihološku realnost). Tradicionalni SEO optimizuje za upit. Ja optimizujem za realnost.

.reveal-content:nth-of-type(1).en: A query for hiking footwear needing product specs and filtering options
.reveal-content:nth-of-type(1).bs: Upit za planinarske čizme koje zahtijevaju specifikacije proizvoda i opcije filtriranja

.reveal-content:nth-of-type(2).en: A person who agreed to a trail before knowing what "trail" meant, now fearing:
.reveal-content:nth-of-type(2).bs: Osoba koja je pristala na planinarenje prije nego što je uopšte saznala šta to podrazumijeva, a sada se pribojava:

.exit-content.en: She bounces back to Google and types "do I really need hiking shoes for Zion"
.exit-content.bs: Vraća se na Google i kuca "da li su mi zaista potrebne planinarske čizme za planinarenje na Maglić"

.exit-insight.en: That's not a UX problem. That's an unresolved anomalous state of knowledge.
.exit-insight.bs: To nije UX problem. To je neriješeno anomalno stanje znanja.

.approach-wrong .approach-desc.en: 140 products filtered by Gore-Tex and EVA midsoles
.approach-wrong .approach-desc.bs: 140 proizvoda filtrirano po Gore-Texu i EVA đonovima

.approach-right .approach-desc.en: One headline: "Don't ruin your trip with the wrong boots" + Three questions to diagnose actual need
.approach-right .approach-desc.bs: Jedan naslov: "Ne pokvarite svoje putovanje pogrešnim čizmama" + Tri pitanja za dijagnozu stvarne potrebe

.cognitive-text.en: Solve for the why behind the query, and the conversion follows. The brand that optimizes for what users say gets the bounce. The brand that optimizes for why users search gets the conversion.
.cognitive-text.bs: Riješite 'zašto' iza upita, konverzija će slijediti. Brend koji optimizuje za to šta korisnici kažu dobijaju odlazak. Brend koji optimizuje za to zašto korisnici pretražuju dobija konverziju.

#seo-nothing-random .ps-content.en: In modern SEO, every word, link, heading, and URL is a deliberate signal. Search engines read your site like an analyst reads a document—they follow structure, verify facts, and remember consistency.
#seo-nothing-random .ps-content.bs: U modernom SEO-u, svaka riječ, link, naslov i URL predstavljaju namjerni signal. Pretraživači čitaju vaš sajt kao što analitičar čita dokument — prate strukturu, provjeravaju činjenice i vrednuju konzistentnost.

#seo .principle-item:nth-child(1) .princ.en: Promise and Deliver the Same Thing
Your URL, title, and main heading must promise the same thing. When they align, search engines categorize your page instantly. When they contradict, confidence drops.
#seo .principle-item:nth-child(1) .princ.bs: Vaš URL, naslov stranice i glavni podnaslov moraju obećavati istu stvar. Kada su usklađeni, pretraživači trenutno kategorizuju vašu stranicu. Kada su u suprotnosti, povjerenje opada.

#seo .principle-item:nth-child(2) .princ.en: Order Information for How People Read
#seo .principle-item:nth-child(2) .princ.bs: Redoslijed informacija za to kako ljudi čitaju

#seo .principle-item:nth-child(2) .princ.en: Lead with benefits, follow with facts. Search engines read top-to-bottom, so put cognitive answers before technical details. Structure content for how humans actually process information.
#seo .principle-item:nth-child(2) .princ.bs: Počnite sa prednostima, a nastavite sa činjenicama. Pretraživači čitaju od vrha prema dolje, stoga stavite kognitivne odgovore prije tehničkih detalja. Strukturirajte sadržaj na način na koji ljudi zapravo obrađuju informacije.

#seo .principle-item:nth-child(3) .princ.en: Internal links aren't navigation—they're relationships between topics. When pages link logically, search engines understand your knowledge structure and crawl it efficiently.
#seo .principle-item:nth-child(3) .princ.bs: Interni linkovi nisu samo navigacija — oni predstavljaju relacije između tema. Kada stranice linkuju logički, pretraživači razumiju vašu strukturu znanja te je efikasno indeksiraju.

#seo .technical-note-text.en: This is how content becomes extractable for AI systems like Google's Knowledge Graph, ChatGPT, and Perplexity. Structured relationships beat keyword stuffing every time.
#seo .technical-note-text.bs: Na ovaj način sadržaj postaje lako prepoznatljiv i upotrebljiv za AI sisteme kao što su Google Knowledge Graph, ChatGPT i Perplexity. Strukturirane semantičke veze svaki put pobjeđuju vještačko pretrpavanje ključnim riječima (keyword stuffing).

#seo .seo-cta-text.en: If your site feels like it's guessing, it is. Let's replace the guesswork with a Topical Map, a Contextual Blueprint, and a semantic network engineered to win.
#seo .seo-cta-text.bs: Ako vaš sajt izgleda kao da nagađa, tako i jeste. Zamijenimo nagađanje tematskom mapom, kontekstualnim planom i semantičkom mrežom dizajniranom za pobjedu.

#capabilities .section-desc.en: A decade as a founder and multidisciplinary maker has forged a unique set of transferable skills. I don't just write code or design hardware; I solve complex problems from concept to market.
#capabilities .section-desc.bs: Decenija u ulogama osnivača i multidisciplinarnog kreatora izgradila je jedinstven set prenosivih vještina. Ne bavim se samo pisanjem koda ili dizajnom hardvera — rješavam složene probleme od koncepta do tržišta.

#capabilities .cap-card:nth-child(1) .ca.en: Managed end-to-end product lifecycles for a decade. From napkin sketches to international distribution and manufacturing.
#capabilities .cap-card:nth-child(1) .ca.bs: Vodio sam cijeli životni ciklus proizvoda tokom protekle decenije — od skica na salveti do međunarodne distribucije i proizvodnje.

#capabilities .cap-card:nth-child(2) .ca.en: Rapidly bridging the gap between hardware and software. Proficient in PCB design, firmware (C), and modern web stacks.
#capabilities .cap-card:nth-child(2) .ca.bs: Brzo premošćivanje jaza između hardvera i softvera. Iskusno vladam dizajnom štampanih ploča (PCB), firmwareom (C) i modernim web tehnologijama.

#capabilities .cap-card:nth-child(3) .ca.en: Experienced in navigating complex supply chains across three countries, factory negotiations, and quality control.
#capabilities .cap-card:nth-child(3) .ca.bs: Iskustvo u vođenju složenih lanaca snabdijevanja kroz tri zemlje, pregovorima s fabrikama i kontroli kvaliteta.

#capabilities .cap-card:nth-child(4) .ca.en: Running my own products taught me how to estimate development tasks accurately, manage technical debt, write clean self-documenting OOP code, and set up robust CI/CD pipelines for seamless deployments.
#capabilities .cap-card:nth-child(4) .ca.bs: Vođenje sopstvenih proizvoda naučilo me kako tačno procijeniti razvojne zadatke, upravljati tehničkim dugom, pisati čist i samodokumentujući OOP kod, te postaviti robusne CI/CD pipeline-e.

.about-intro.en: I specialize in building and scaling e-commerce websites with SEO at the foundation—not as an afterthought, but as the core architecture. I spent the last decade founding, building, and scaling products, bringing that founder's ownership mindset to high-performance engineering teams.
.about-intro.bs: Specijalizorao sam se za izradu i skaliranje e-commerce web-stranica sa integrisanim SEO-om. Prošlu deceniju proveo sam osnivajući, gradeći i skalirajući proizvode, unoseći osnivački mentalitet i osjećaj za preuzimanje odgovornosti (ownership) u visokoperformansne inženjerske timove.

.about-differentiator .about-text.en: I don't just execute features—I've lived with the consequences of bad technical decisions. I've managed technical debt as a founder managing real customer impact, not as a developer inheriting someone else's problems.
.about-differentiator .about-text.bs: Ja ne razvijam samo funkcionalnosti — živio sam s posljedicama loših tehničkih odluka. Tehničkim dugom sam upravljao kao osnivač koji direktno osjeća uticaj tih odluka na stvarne kupce, a ne samo kao programer koji nasljeđuje tuđe probleme.

.about-background .about-text:nth-child(.en: It started with taking things apart. As a kid, I dismantled every toy I owned to understand what was inside. When my father rigged a sewing machine motor to generate electricity during power outages during the war, something clicked. I needed to know how systems worked—from the inside out.
.about-background .about-text:nth-child(.bs: Sve je počelo rastavljanjem stvari. Kao dijete, rastavio bih svaku igračku koju sam imao kako bih shvatio šta je unutra. Kada je moj otac prilagodio motor šivaće mašine da generiše struju tokom ratnih redukcija, nešto je kliknulo. Morao sam saznati kako sistemi funkcionišu iznutra.

.about-background .about-text:nth-child(.en: That curiosity never left. I launched Bosnia's first STEM toy product, led youth organizations, and built e-commerce platforms. Each experience taught me the same lesson: technical skill without business context is just clever engineering that doesn't matter.
.about-background .about-text:nth-child(.bs: Ta radoznalost me nikada nije napustila. Lansirao sam prvu bosansku STEM igračku (STEM Pionir), vodio omladinske organizacije i gradio e-commerce platforme. Svako iskustvo me je naučilo istoj lekciji: tehnička vještina bez poslovnog konteksta je samo pametan inženjering koji nema stvarnu vrijednost.

.about-workstyle .about-text:nth-child(2.en: I value autonomy, ownership, and direct communication. Running organizations taught me that the best work happens when you understand the business behind the code. I don't just build features, I ask what problem we're actually solving and for whom.
.about-workstyle .about-text:nth-child(2.bs: Cijenim autonomiju, preuzimanje odgovornosti i direktnu komunikaciju. Vođenje organizacija me naučilo da se najbolji rezultati postižu kada razumijete poslovnu logiku iza koda. Ne razvijam samo funkcionalnosti, ja postavljam pitanje koji problem zapravo rješavamo i za koga.

.about-workstyle .about-text:nth-child(3.en: I prefer autonomy over hand-holding, but I ask questions instead of making assumptions. Technical decisions should be guided by business impact, not technical convenience.
.about-workstyle .about-text:nth-child(3.bs: Preferiram autonomiju umjesto stalnog nadzora, ali postavljam pitanja umjesto da donosim pretpostavke. Tehničke odluke moraju biti vođene poslovnim uticajem, a ne tehničkom pogodnošću.

.about-personal .about-text:nth-child(2).en: When I'm not coding, you'll find me exploring how search psychology influences buying decisions or researching why certain products succeed while others fail. I'm obsessed with understanding what happens in that moment before someone clicks—the thinking they don't yet know they're doing.
.about-personal .about-text:nth-child(2).bs: Kad ne kodiram, pronaći ćete me u istraživanju uticaja psihologije pretrage na odluke o kupovini ili u potrazi za odgovorima zašto određeni proizvodi uspijevaju dok drugi propadaju. Opsjednut sam razumijevanjem šta se dešava u trenutku prije nego neko klikne (podsvjesnog procesa razmišljanja).

.about-personal .about-text:nth-child(3).en: Currently based in Tešanj, open to opportunities where I can bring both technical depth and business awareness to meaningful work.
.about-personal .about-text:nth-child(3).bs: Trenutno živim u Tešnju, otvoren za prilike gdje mogu donijeti i tehničku dubinu i poslovnu svijest značajnom radu.
